The '''Mark III bulk transport''' was a product of [[Sienar Ships]], basically an oversized version of the [[Mark I Bulk Transport|Mark I bulk transport]].

[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces used a Mark III bulk transport as bait to lure [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] or [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] into a trap.
